title: Pastel drive: where smart object sorting beats modeling for 3D quality
author: ALbera_Uhata
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/wi1xmzrsbgxh1.gif

I wasn't satisfied with the way my in-game scenes were looking so I made the logical decision to overhaul my process based on what I've gleaned from the creation of the Pinocchio asset.

I now use the Tripo Vibe Gaming Playbook as my reference guide.

You simply list your 7 - 16 movable objects per scene and wait for that list to be approved before you start any modeling at all. Simply because you add more objects to the scene achieves a higher density without any detailing.

While we were in our workshop, we had 26 movable objects on our list and did not even touch the mesh until the list was approved.

Additionally, it will work well with dense scenes but has its limitations because it will require some forethought regarding modeling so that you don't run into any problems with excess detail on book spines or patterned pottery.

Give me a shout back with some of your scenes so that I can see if this works for you. Let me know if you encounter any issues with this in your pipeline as I am still fine-tuning my process.
